about.paragraph1: I'm a Junior Full-Stack Developer focused on building modern, responsive and practical web applications.
about.paragraph2: I work with React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript, along with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Supabase. I build responsive interfaces, backend APIs and database-driven applications.
